remarks: Tucked at the end of a quiet cul-de-sac in coveted Hillcrest Park, this superbly renovated 5-bedroom, 3.1-bath Colonial offers 5,213 square feet of refined living on 1.11 manicured acres in the heart of Old Greenwich, CT. Close to top-rated North Mianus Elementary School and just minutes from the Old Greenwich train station, downtown shops, and the beach, this is the rare Greenwich estate that delivers space, privacy, and walkability in equal measure. A double-height entry with gleaming hardwood floors sets the tone, opening to a sun-filled living room with fireplace and French doors, formal dining room, and a stunning chef's kitchen featuring a Sub-Zero refrigerator, Dacor double ovens, wine refrigerator, large center island, and a built-in eating area. The main level also includes a library/den, family room with fireplace and French doors to the terrace, and a powder room. Upstairs, the primary suite is a private retreat with a walk-in dressing area and bath. Four additional bedrooms, two full baths, a dedicated laundry room, and a flexible office/sitting area complete the second floor. The finished lower level adds a media room, playroom, and studio ideal for entertaining, working from home, or growing families. Additional features include central air, a 2-car attached garage, security system, expansive deck and terrace, and beautifully landscaped grounds. Renovated in 2016 and meticulously maintained.
